result.title: How Bain Capital Is Scaling AI with ChatGPT
result.description:
For businesses, AI is most powerful when everyone can use it.

“Having 2,700 employees, all of whom now have an enterprise ChatGPT license, has just been a giant force multiplier for the business.” -James Mackey, Bain Capital

See how Bain Capital portfolio company Zelis is using ChatGPT to streamline claims processing and help reduce costs across the healthcare system.
